title.zh: 将卡加延省Faire市镇更名为Santo Niño的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of Faire in the Province of Cagayan to Santo Niño
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of Faire in the Province of Cagayan to Santo Niño
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Thị trấn Faire tại Tỉnh Cagayan thành Santo Niño
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อเทศบาล Faire ในจังหวัด Cagayan เป็น Santo Niño
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Kotamadya Faire di Provinsi Cagayan menjadi Santo Niño
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Perbandaran Faire di Wilayah Cagayan menjadi Santo Niño

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5644_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Municipality of Faire, in the Province of Cagayan is hereby changed to Santo Niño.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
